hook.text: The classic dilemma has two players. Scale it to thousands and the problem gets exponentially harder.

buildup.text: Each person's defection has a tiny individual impact but a massive collective one.

discovery.text: Climate change is a multi-player dilemma: each country gains by polluting while others cut back.

twist.text: With many players, monitoring and punishment become nearly impossible. Free-riding thrives.

climax.text: Solutions require coordination: treaties, regulations, or shared monitoring systems.

punchline.text: More players, more temptation to cheat.
